card.name: Joiners inside combination drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking marks right after a drug salt or ingredient name, such as 'and', '/', '(' or 'mg' in a combination product name. It also fires inside the long name dimenhydrinate.

modes.label: 'and' between salts
modes.description: The word 'and' joining two ingredients of a combination drug right after 'hydrochloride'.

modes.description: A '/' or 'mg' inside a paired-ingredient strength listing.

modes.label: Bracket after dye name
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after the dye name FD&C Yellow No. 5 before tartrazine.
modes.example: 5.10 FD&C Yellow No. 5<< (>>Tartrazine) This product contains FD
